groups.noteTitle: Feedback on second year of Performance Arts Course

questions.text: Gina chose to study performance arts at this university because the course
Which of the options they chose have Gina and Charlie both found useful?
What did Charlie do during his work experience?

options.t: He worked in a costume department.
He performed with a ballet company.
He helped out at a dance school for children.

questions.text: What does Gina say she learnt from her work experience?

options.t: how to organise her time better
how to work better in a team
how to cope when under pressure

questions.text: What does Charlie say about his dissertation topic?

options.t: He wanted it to be different from those of other students.
He had already done an assignment in this area.
He was inspired to choose it by a performance he saw.

questions.text: Which aspect of writing a dissertation is Gina worried about?

options.t: presenting it in an appropriate way

groups.instruction: What do the students say about each of the following types of careers in performance arts? Choose FOUR answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-F, next to questions 27-30.

bank.t: There is a lot of competition.
People with experience feel very positive about it.
It is a relatively unpopular choice.
